title: sida hermaphrodita
intro: Sida hermaphrodita, commonly known as country mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida hermaphrodita include reducing fever, treating various skin conditions, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
